h1: The 7 Best Small Handheld Vacuums of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Small Handheld Vacuums: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: seven compact cordless handheld vacuums compared on power, storage size, pet hair tools and included accessories.
summary: The Shark WANDVAC is our top pick because it has the slimmest storage profile of a recognized brand, which is what a small handheld is for. The BLACK+DECKER 20V Dustbuster is the choice if you want confirmed power in a compact body. The Dustbuster AdvancedClean adds a charging station and crevice tool, and the Furbuster is the one for pet hair.
intro: People buy a handheld vacuum for the small mess, then abandon it in a drawer because it is awkward to reach. The honest test of a compact vacuum is not suction on paper, it is whether it lives somewhere you will actually grab it. A slim, wall-mountable body gets used, and a bulky one does not.

We reviewed seven small cordless handheld vacuums and ranked them on size and storage, power class, included tools and pet hair ability. Findings come from product listings and stated features rather than any claim of home trials.

products.name: Shark WANDVAC Cordless Hand Vac, Black, WV201BK
products.verdict: A slim cordless hand vac from a major brand that stores almost anywhere.
products.description:
The Shark WANDVAC is a compact cordless hand vacuum with a slim storage profile. It comes from a recognized household brand.

It ranks first because storage footprint is what makes a handheld useful, and this is the slimmest here. The BLACK+DECKER 20V below it states its power class, which the Shark listing does not.

Buy it for quick cleanups from a small drawer or shelf. The caveat is that it sits in the $50-100 bucket and does not state a voltage.
products.idealFor: Small homes where storage space is limited.
products.skipIf: You want a stated voltage or pet tools.

products.name: BLACK+DECKER Dustbuster 20V Hand Vacuum Cordless Rechargeable
products.verdict: A 20V compact Dustbuster with an extendible crevice tool.
products.description:
This Dustbuster runs on 20V, keeps a compact body and includes an extendible crevice tool.

It ranks second because it puts a concrete power class on a small tool, but the Shark below it is easier to store. Compared with the 8V model, 20V is a real step up.

Choose it if you want confirmed power without a bulky unit. The caveat is that it costs in the $50-100 bucket.
products.idealFor: People who want stated power in a small tool.
products.skipIf: Storage space is the first concern.

products.name: Black+Decker Dustbuster AdvancedClean Handheld Vacuum Cordless, Compact Home and Car Vacuum
products.verdict: A compact Dustbuster with a charging station and crevice tool.
products.description:
The AdvancedClean is a compact cordless hand vacuum for home and car with a crevice tool and a charging station in the box.

It ranks third because the included station keeps it charged where you store it, and the price in the $25-50 bucket is low. It does not state a voltage.

Buy it for a household that wants compact design with accessories. The caveat is that power is not specified.
products.idealFor: People who want accessories with a wall-ready dock.

products.name: Bissell Pet Hair Eraser Cordless Hand Vacuum, Home, Auto & Pet, 2390A
products.verdict: A compact cordless vac built around pet hair removal from a known brand.
products.description:
The Pet Hair Eraser is a compact cordless hand vacuum from Bissell, with a design aimed at pet hair on furniture, stairs and in the car.

It ranks fourth because it is pet-focused, whereas the BLACK+DECKER Furbuster adds a motorized brush. It sits in the $50-100 bucket.

Choose it for pet owners who want a recognized brand. The caveat is that the listing gives few other specs.
products.idealFor: Pet owners wanting a branded compact vac.
products.skipIf: You want a motorized pet brush.

products.name: BLACK+DECKER Dustbuster Furbuster Pet Hair Vacuum with Motorized Pet Hair Brush
products.verdict: A rechargeable handheld with a motorized brush for stubborn pet hair.
products.description:
The Furbuster is a compact rechargeable Dustbuster with a motorized pet hair brush, for home and car.

It ranks fifth because the motorized brush is a real edge on upholstery, while it adds bulk over the slimmer picks above.

Buy it for a home with shedding pets. The caveat is that the brush adds weight.
products.skipIf: You want the slimmest possible tool.

products.name: Shark Cyclone PET Handheld Vacuum, Navy Blue/Grey, CH701
products.verdict: A compact Shark with cyclone technology and a pet focus.
products.description:
The Shark Cyclone PET is a compact handheld that uses cyclone technology, from a recognized brand.

It ranks sixth because the listing details are thin next to the WANDVAC. Think of it as the cheaper door into the Shark name, priced between $50 and $100.

Choose it if you trust Shark and want a pet-friendly compact tool. The caveat is limited stated specs.
products.idealFor: Shark fans wanting a compact pet vac.
products.skipIf: You want a stated voltage or tools.

products.name: BLACK+DECKER Dustbuster Handheld Vacuum, 8V Cordless, Hand Vacuum for Quick Cleanup
products.verdict: An 8V Dustbuster sized for quick, light messes, with a washable filter.
products.description:
The 8V Dustbuster is a compact cordless vacuum designed for quick cleanups, with a washable filter, and costs under $50.

The bottom spot is down to the fact that 8V is the lowest power class here, behind the 20V model. It is the easy pick for crumbs and small spills.

Buy it as a light-duty counter or desk tool. The caveat is limited power.

whatMatters.detail: A handheld that stores slimly gets used. Wall mounts or slim bodies help. Look for 'wall mount' or 'slim' in the listing.
Voltage is a rough power class, with 20V stronger than 8V. Check the listing for a voltage figure.
A crevice tool reaches car seats and corners. Look for it in the included accessories.
A motorized brush lifts hair from upholstery better than suction alone. Look for 'motorized brush' in the title.
A washable filter saves replacement costs. Check the listing for the term.

howToChoose.intro: What you clean decides the pick.

rows: Bissell Pet Hair Eraser or Furbuster

cards.label: Slim body
cards.text: The Shark WANDVAC stores almost anywhere, so it gets used more.

cards.label: Higher voltage
cards.text: The 20V Dustbuster states more power, while the 8V model is the lightest class.

howToChoose.note: Most small homes should default to the slim body, the Shark WANDVAC, unless power is the priority.

cards.label: Look for
cards.text: A crevice tool and a body that stores in the car or a nearby shelf.

cards.label: In this ranking
cards.text: The AdvancedClean lists home and car use with a crevice tool, and the 20V has an extendible one.

cards.label: Spend more if
cards.text: You want a recognized brand or stated power, so the Shark WANDVAC or the 20V Dustbuster is worth it.

cards.label: Save if
cards.text: You only clean crumbs. The 8V Dustbuster is enough.

faq.a: They are meant for light messes. Higher voltage such as 20V gives more power than 8V.
Buying on power alone. If the vacuum is awkward to store, you will not use it.

faq.q: Is the 20V Dustbuster worth it over the 8V?
faq.a: For heavier messes yes. For crumbs, the 8V is enough.

faq.q: How do I look after the filter?
faq.a: Tap out dust regularly and wash if the filter is washable, then dry completely before reuse.

faq.q: Can I use these in a car?
faq.a: Several list car use. A crevice tool helps with seats.

faq.q: Will they pick up pet hair?
faq.a: The Furbuster has a motorized brush for pet hair. Others rely on suction alone.

finalTake: The Shark WANDVAC is the best small handheld for most homes because it is easy to store and therefore easy to use. Pick the 20V Dustbuster for power, the AdvancedClean for accessories, and the Furbuster for pet hair.
